request.style: English, smoky swing jazz, sultry female vocal, big band horns, walking bass, piano, brushed swing drums, dark and dramatic, 108 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
King Belshazzar threw a party for a thousand of his lords
They drank the wine from the temple cups and laughed at the holy things
They praised the gods of silver and the gods of gold and stone
Then a hand came out of nowhere and the laughter died alone

[Verse]
The fingers wrote upon the plaster by the lampstand's light
The king's face turned to ashes and his knees knocked in the night
No wise man in the city could read the words or tell
So they called for the old exile, Daniel, who knew God well

[Chorus]
MENE, MENE, TEKEL, and PARSIN
You have been weighed on the scales
And found too light
Weighed on the scales and found too light

[Bridge]
God has numbered the days of your kingdom
And brought it to an end
Your kingdom has been divided
And given to the Medes and Persians

[Chorus]
MENE, MENE, TEKEL, and PARSIN
You have been weighed on the scales
And found too light
Weighed on the scales and found too light

[Outro]
That very night the king was slain
Weighed on the scales
